faqs.q: Are these PDF tools really free?
faqs.a: Yes. Every tool on Papyrus is free to use with no ads and no signup required. Anonymous users can start instantly, with generous daily limits, and signing in raises them.

title: Compress PDF — Papyrus
metaDescription: Compress PDF files online for free, no signup. Shrink PDF size while keeping quality. Private processing, files auto-deleted in 24 hours. Try Papyrus now.
intro: Compress PDF files to make them smaller while keeping the text and images readable. Free, no signup, and private — your file is processed for you alone and auto-deleted within 24 hours.
steps: Drop your PDF into the box above (up to 25MB, 500 pages for anonymous use).
Pick a compression preset: low, medium, high, or extreme.
Preview the estimated savings before you commit.
Run the compression and your smaller PDF downloads automatically.

faqs.q: How much can I shrink my PDF?
faqs.a: It depends on what's inside. Image-heavy PDFs often drop by 50-80% on the high or extreme preset, while text-only files compress less. Papyrus previews the estimated savings before you run, so you can choose the right balance.

faqs.q: Will compressing reduce the quality of my PDF?
faqs.a: The low and medium presets keep quality visually intact; high and extreme trade some image sharpness for a smaller file. Text stays crisp at every level. Use the preview to compare before downloading.

faqs.q: Is it really free and private?
faqs.a: Yes. Compressing a PDF on Papyrus is free with no signup and no ads. Your file is processed privately and automatically deleted within 24 hours.
